remarks: Welcome to 115 Juniata! This well-maintained and cozy ranch is nestled on a dead-end street in South Buffalo, conveniently located close to the 90 and minutes from downtown Buffalo. Inside, you’ll find beautiful hardwood floors throughout the living room and all three bedrooms, along with a full bathroom conveniently connected to the primary bedroom. The kitchen offers plenty of space for everyday cooking and functionality, with a natural flow into the living room that makes the layout comfortable and inviting. The basement provides additional potential for a recreation or entertainment space, or plenty of room for storage. Step outside to enjoy a composite deck with vinyl railings, refreshed landscaping, a long concrete driveway, a detached two-car garage, and a spacious, fully fenced backyard. Recent updates include a new furnace and all-new windows in 2023, along with refreshed landscaping, offering added peace of mind for the next owner. With its comfortable layout, great outdoor space, and valuable updates, this home is ready for its next chapter! Showings begin immediately. The seller reserves the right to establish an offer deadline, if applicable. Open Houses: Wednesday, October 14th, from 5:00–7:00 PM & Saturday, October 17th, from 1:00–3:00 PM
